test_cases.title: Clicking Users nav renders the dedicated Users page with active-state highlighting
test_cases.given: the sidebar is rendered and the app is on the Dashboard view
test_cases.when: the Admin clicks the "Users" nav item
test_cases.then: the app renders the new Users page (not Dashboard), and the "Users" nav item shows its active/highlighted state

test_cases.title: Users page header shows the "+ Add User" button
test_cases.given: the Users page has loaded
test_cases.then: a "+ Add User" button is present, consistent with the existing page-header pattern

test_cases.title: Four stats cards render with Total/Active/Inactive/Admin values
test_cases.given: GET /api/dashboard/stats resolves with total_users=8, active_users=5, admin_users=2
test_cases.when: the Users page stats cards render
test_cases.then: Total shows 8, Active shows 5, Admin shows 2, and Inactive shows 3 (8 - 5), each via the StatsCard component

test_cases.title: Inactive stat derivation is verified against a known dataset
test_cases.given: a dashboard-stats response with total_users=8 and active_users=5
test_cases.then: the computed Inactive value equals 3, confirming the total - active derivation documented in the code comment

test_cases.title: UserTable renders with columns ID, Name, Email, Phone, Role, Status, Created, Actions
test_cases.given: the user list request resolves with at least one user
test_cases.then: the table shows columns ID, Name, Email, Phone, Role, Status, Created, and Actions using the existing UserTable component

test_cases.title: Non-empty search value on the Users page debounces 300ms before firing a request
test_cases.given: the Admin has focused the Users page search input and no request has fired yet
test_cases.when: the Admin types a non-empty value
test_cases.then: getUsers({ search, ... }) is not called until 300ms of fake-timer time has elapsed, then is called exactly once with the typed value

test_cases.title: Clearing the Users page search input triggers an immediate (0ms) refetch
test_cases.given: the Admin has a non-empty search value entered on the Users page
test_cases.when: the Admin clears the search input to an empty string
test_cases.then: getUsers is called immediately (0ms delay) with an empty/omitted search param

test_cases.title: Changing Role or Status filter refetches immediately and resets to page 1
test_cases.given: the Users page is on page 3 with no filters active
test_cases.when: the Admin selects a Role or Status filter
test_cases.then: the user list re-fetches immediately (no debounce) with the new filter applied and the page resets to 1

test_cases.title: Clicking a row's view icon opens the full user detail via UserDetails
test_cases.given: the Users table has rendered with at least one row
test_cases.when: the Admin clicks a row's view icon
test_cases.then: GET /api/users/{id} is called and the full user record is displayed via UserDetails

test_cases.title: Adding a user with valid data succeeds: modal closes, toast shown, list and stats refresh
test_cases.given: the Admin has opened the "+ Add User" form and filled in valid data
test_cases.when: the form is submitted and POST /api/users succeeds
test_cases.then: the modal closes, a success toast is shown, and the user list and stats both refresh

test_cases.title: Adding a user with a duplicate email surfaces a 409 error inline without closing the modal
test_cases.given: the Admin submits the "+ Add User" form with an email that already exists
test_cases.then: the form surfaces the server's error message inline, the modal remains open, and no raw stack trace is shown

test_cases.title: Editing a user with valid changes succeeds: modal closes, toast shown, list/stats refresh
test_cases.given: the Admin has opened the edit form for an existing user with valid changes
test_cases.when: the form is submitted and PUT /api/users/{id} succeeds
test_cases.then: the modal closes, a success toast is shown, and the list and stats refresh

test_cases.title: Editing a user that fails shows a readable inline error, never a raw stack trace
test_cases.given: the Admin submits the edit form
test_cases.then: a readable error is shown inline in the form and the modal does not close; regression-covered by frontend/src/pages/__tests__/Users.crud.test.jsx 'USR-01-TC-13: a failed Edit User submission keeps the modal open and shows the server error inline' (mocks updateUser rejection, asserts inline error text and that the Edit User modal remains present)

attempts.reason: No committed test asserts the edit-failure inline-error path; PLAN.md T-06 Notes claim coverage of TC-13 but Users.crud.test.jsx has no updateUser.mockRejected(...) case (grep confirmed). Functional behavior itself verified correct via an ad-hoc throwaway test (not committed) -- this is a coverage gap, not a runtime defect.
Added committed regression test 'USR-01-TC-13' to Users.crud.test.jsx mocking updateUser rejection; asserts inline error text and modal stays open. Full frontend suite green.

test_cases.title: Confirming delete calls DELETE, shows a success toast, and refreshes list/stats
test_cases.given: the Admin clicks a row's delete icon and the confirmation dialog is shown
test_cases.then: DELETE /api/users/{id} is called, a success toast is shown, and the list and stats refresh

test_cases.title: Canceling the delete confirmation makes no request and leaves the row unchanged
test_cases.given: the delete confirmation dialog is shown for a row
test_cases.then: no DELETE request is made and the row remains unchanged in the table

test_cases.title: Pagination Previous/Next navigates pages and disables at boundaries
test_cases.given: more users exist than fit on one page (PAGE_SIZE = 50)
test_cases.then: the table refetches the corresponding page; "Previous" is disabled on page 1 and "Next" is disabled on the last page

test_cases.title: Loading states render for stats and table on initial page load
test_cases.given: the initial GET /api/users and GET /api/dashboard/stats calls are in flight
test_cases.then: loading states are shown for both the stats cards and the table

test_cases.title: Empty state shown when zero users exist with no filters active
test_cases.given: the backend returns zero users and no search/filter is active
test_cases.then: the UserTable empty state is shown (hasActiveFilters = false)

test_cases.title: No-results state shown when zero users match an active search/filter
test_cases.given: the backend returns zero users because a search/filter is active
test_cases.then: a "no results for this filter" state is shown (hasActiveFilters = true)

test_cases.title: User-list fetch failure shows an inline banner; stats fetch failure shows a non-blocking toast
test_cases.given: GET /api/users fails
test_cases.then: a readable inline error banner is shown near the table, never a raw stack trace; and when GET /api/dashboard/stats fails separately, a non-blocking error toast is shown and the page remains usable

test_cases.title: Dashboard.search.test.jsx is preserved (not deleted) after the extraction
test_cases.given: the Users.jsx extraction has been completed
test_cases.when: the frontend test suite is inspected
test_cases.then: frontend/src/pages/__tests__/Dashboard.search.test.jsx still exists and asserts against behavior actually present in its target component (Dashboard or Users, per migration strategy) — it is not deleted or left asserting stale behavior

test_cases.title: Users-page test suite reaches parity with the original Dashboard.search.test.jsx coverage
test_cases.given: the original Dashboard.search.test.jsx test case list (debounce, immediate-clear, filter behavior, pagination, accessibility label)
test_cases.when: the Users-page-scoped test suite is run
test_cases.then: every original test case is represented (directly or via an equivalent migrated assertion) with no coverage silently dropped

test_cases.title: Users page list requests stay paginated and search stays rate-bounded by the 300ms debounce
test_cases.given: the Admin types continuously into the Users page search box for 2 seconds
test_cases.when: getUsers calls are counted and the page/pageSize params are inspected
test_cases.then: no more than one getUsers call fires per 300ms of continuous typing, and every call includes page/pageSize with pageSize = 50 (no unbounded fetch)

test_cases.title: Users page components route all HTTP calls exclusively through userApi.js
test_cases.given: the source of Users.jsx and any new components it introduces
test_cases.then: no module imports axios directly; all HTTP calls go through frontend/src/services/userApi.js

last_run.artefact: grep -rn axios frontend/src/pages frontend/src/App.jsx (no direct import found)

test_cases.title: Users page toolbar controls expose accessible labels
test_cases.given: the Users page is loaded
test_cases.when: the search input and Role/Status filter selects are queried
test_cases.then: each carries an appropriate aria-label (or associated label), matching the accessibility affordances already present on the equivalent Dashboard controls
